title: Extract global product state into a ProductStore struct in Go legacy products API
description: The Go products API uses package-level global variables for state (store, nextID, mu). Refactor to a ProductStore struct with method receivers while keeping all existing tests passing via package-level wrapper functions.

required_artifacts: Package-level Handler and ResetStore delegate to defaultStore
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
